info.name: Dynamic Form Builder API
info.description:
Run **Authentication > Login (Admin)** or **Login (User)** first - the token is stored automatically.
Then run requests top-to-bottom: IDs (formId, formSlug, responseId, taskId, filePath) are captured by test scripts.

request.description: Self-registration (role = User). Returns 409 if the email exists.
Deletes the user and their forms. Prefer is_active=false.
Creates a form with all 9 field types and a conditional field.
Must contain ALL field ids of the form. Get them from 'Get Form'.
Replaces the complete field list - items with id are updated, without id created, missing ones deleted. Use on a scratch form!
Select a PDF in the 'file' form-data field. Use the returned file_path as the answer.
Enable query params to search / filter.
Send the complete answer set. Owner/Admin always; submitter only if allow_response_edit and form active.
